text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(...Both Creek-san and I missed out on 
victory. However—)

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...I won't let it end like this~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Next time, I will win.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(She will undoubtedly stand before me 
again, having grown into an even more 
formidable rival—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(When that time comes, we will clash with 
even greater heart and soul than today, 
reaching an even higher plane. I'm certain 
of it...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(Right now, that's just... purely 
delightful!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—It looks like we'll have more rivals to 
overcome.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yaeno-san—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"The next time we cross paths, the battle 
will undoubtedly be even fiercer."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
“—However, that is precisely what we 
desire. Wouldn't you agree?”

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes. That's right.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Next time, victory shall be mine.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Then I shall stand in your way. —As your 
worthy rival."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...While I can hardly say I achieved the 
best result this time, it was a great 
personal takeaway for me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Those whom I wish to surpass. Those who 
could be my rivals exist in great numbers 
right "now" at this very moment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
“And the match against them will 
undoubtedly be something magnificent to 
which I can devote my entire heart and 
soul—”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I realized that firsthand……
choice_data_list:
How did Aldan feel when she experienced 
that for herself?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...I am most delighted.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
As long as beloved rivals exist, the 
limits I am able to surpass are truly 
infinite—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Because the brilliance this body emits, 
the trail of light it traces, shall become 
infinitely dazzling...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After a fierce battle against a new 
formidable rival, Mejiro Ardan seemed to 
sense the first sprouts of her own growth.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...With the Classic year nearing its end, 
the battles against her rivals will only 
become even fiercer from here on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It might be best to take a breather before 
the next goal and focus on taking her 
abilities up another notch.
choice_data_list: Next, let's aim for the Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"It's the classic royal road race to 
determine the strongest middle-distance 
runner of the spring, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sure a magnificent radiance will 
gather there once again.
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to competing already.
I'm looking forward to competing already.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Is it really all right? For my heart to 
dance with this much joy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Surely that excitement will turn her 
running into something even more dazzling 
and vivid.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...If that is what you say, Trainer, then 
I can surrender myself to these feelings 
without any reservations."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Let's head back and review today's 
performance right away. I want to check 
Creek-san's run one more time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, unable to contain her soaring 
excitement, I hurried back to the academy 
together with Mejiro Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And at almost the exact same time—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"—This year's Kikuka Sho was another 
fierce battle, wasn't it? Fans are already 
bursting with anticipation for their next 
race—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Creek-san, Yaeno-san, Ardan-san too... 
Everyone's getting... stronger and 
stronger...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: And yet... I...—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(...It's okay. I can become even 
stronger.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (—No. I must become stronger.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(So that when Chiyono O-san returns 
someday... I will be worthy of being her 
rival...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—The Osaka Hai. There, I will surely shine 
even brighter...!
